resources.string:
Chatrix.One is a fork of Conversations, the XMPP app made by Daniel Gultsch (https://conversations.im).

Chatrix.One adds its own look and quick message gestures. Please report problems with this app to Chatrix.One (https://chatrix.one), not to the Conversations developers.

Like Conversations, Chatrix.One is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.

————————————————
Chatrix.One keeps its own connection open, so Android shows a permanent notification. You can safely turn it off here: messages keep arriving and you still get a warning if the connection fails.

Once a day, look at chatrix.eu for a newer Chatrix.One version and show a notification. Nothing is downloaded or installed and no personal data is sent. Not used when installed from F-Droid or another app store, or when Tor is on.
Tap to open the download page
Free and private messaging on chatrix.one or any other XMPP server. No ads, no tracking.

Created your account on the website? Tap \"I already have an account\" and enter your new chatrix.one address and password.\n\nIf the website offered \"Accept invite using Chatrix.One\", that button finishes everything for you.

The texts Chatrix.One adds to the app were written in English and Bulgarian by the Chatrix.One team. In all other languages they were translated automatically, so a few of them may sound a little unusual. Everything else comes from the Conversations translations. Thank you for your understanding!

Nothing is ever sent in the background. After a crash, Chatrix.One shows you the report (app version, device model, time and the technical error details) and asks first. It is sent to the Chatrix.One team only if you confirm, as an XMPP message from your account or by email. Turn off to never be asked.

Chatrix.One closed unexpectedly. The report below contains the app version, device model, time and the technical error details. Send it to %s to help fix the problem? Nothing is sent unless you choose.
Show a notification when someone reacts to your message. This is the default for all chats; each chat can change it in its menu.
Play a sound for reaction notifications. When off, they arrive silently.
XMPP is a provider-independent instant messaging network. You can use this app with whichever XMPP server you choose.
